setup_actor_critic_agent: build a PPO agent with actor-critic network using MDDPPO or MPPO from config
training_log_wandb: log training rewards, metrics, and losses to Weights and Biases during PPO training
eval_checkpoints: evaluate one or multiple PPO checkpoints by polling a directory and running episodes
eval_single_checkpoint: evaluate a single PPO checkpoint by running episodes and logging aggregated stats to W&B
review_ModifiedPPOTrainer: review the ModifiedPPOTrainer class that extends PPOTrainer with W&B logging and MDDPPO support
